fields.description: If an inbound email cannot be matched to a Contact linked to a Customer, assign the ticket to this Customer for triage (optional).
fields.label: Fallback Customer (Email)

fields.description: For inbound email: ensure Contact is linked to Customer. Optional fallback customer is used when sender cannot be matched.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: URL used by the Support Portal Help Center link. Use a relative path like /help-center or a full https:// URL.
fields.label: Help URL

fields.description: PRAI (Printechs Retail AI Assistant) on the Support Portal. MVP uses FAQ and Help Center search; disable until you are ready to roll out.
fields.label: PRAI (Portal Assistant)

fields.description: Show the PRAI assistant entry in the Support Portal (FAQ-based MVP).
fields.label: Enable PRAI MVP on Portal

fields.description: OpenAI powers PRAI FAQ Import and optional AI chat answers when FAQ/Help do not match.
fields.label: OpenAI (PRAI)

fields.description: Master switch for OpenAI API usage (FAQ Import and chat answers). Requires a valid API key.
fields.label: Enable OpenAI

fields.description: When enabled, PRAI answers any portal question using OpenAI with FAQ/Help context. Verified FAQ matches are still used first.
fields.label: Enable AI Chat Answers

fields.description: OpenAI model name (for example gpt-4o-mini). Used only when OpenAI is enabled.
fields.label: OpenAI Model

fields.description: Automatically close tickets that remain Resolved for this many days. Set 0 to disable auto-close.
fields.label: Ticket Workflow

fields.description: Tickets in Resolved status are automatically moved to Closed after this many days. Set 0 to disable.
fields.label: Auto Close Resolved Tickets After (Days)

fields.description: Fallback email addresses for pending ticket reports, one per line or comma-separated. Team reports are sent to each Support Team's default email, team lead, and members. These fallback recipients are used for teams without emails and for unassigned tickets.
fields.label: Pending Ticket Report Recipients

fields.description: How often to send the pending ticket report, in days.
fields.label: Pending Ticket Report Interval (Days)
